entities.summary: Kartid, a notable figure in the history of Afghanistan, associated with Mongol Invasion and Timurid Afghanistan (1220–1370). Preceded by Mongol Devastation. Their legacy influenced Kartid dynasty rules Herat as Mongol vassals, preserving Persian culture and Timurid Herat Renaissance.
